subject.title: feat(ui): modernize the Control UI dashboard

question: Should OpenClaw adopt Nova plus the new default-collapsed System Settings group as supported Control UI defaults, including a synced persisted theme value?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the product’s default information hierarchy and preference contract; correctness checks cannot determine whether that UX direction is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the visual direction
options.body: Approve the Nova theme and disclosure default after version-skew behavior and representative live proof are documented or covered.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Keep only the independently desired styling changes and defer the new theme or Settings disclosure default to a separate product decision.

options.title: Decline the default changes
options.body: Retain current theme and Settings navigation behavior if the new information hierarchy is not the intended Control UI direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the visual direction
recommendation.body: Approve the Nova theme and disclosure default after version-skew behavior and representative live proof are documented or covered.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate based on prior Control UI visual-refresh history.
